support: four Gaussian sigma; twelve conditional energy lengths
count_model: one marked Poisson measure across all28 band/depth cells in band_depth_joint.npz
sparse_model: complete signed catalog selected by actual parent count, never by participation; shared neighbours and shuffled parent phases
dense_model: positive parent-packet compound-Poisson marginals when weights are rare; correlated first/second packet moments and large-participation central approximation otherwise; no universal Rayleigh
burst: accepted Cox intensity at emission time after burn; energy marginals and full joint count census preserve its delay
interface_model: scalar same-branch impedance R+T=1; grain-reflected redistribution is a distinct receiver remainder, not extra heat
edge_model: conditional ten-percent escape per mean half-foil traverse; finite image receiver versus residence remainder kept distinct
phase_model: wave-vector carrier phase; group-velocity envelope transit; stress-echo pi sign
limitations: guided/bulk and late lateral cavity receiver remainders are conditional, not resonance reproduction
energy jump marginals do not claim a reconstructed cross-depth signed field
spatial widths are shared-neighbour finite/censored measurements
selected frequency transfer refinement supersedes false band-centre tail exclusions
